title: Week of Aug 24–30
subtitle: Block 3, Big-4 retest — Week 2 (first push week). Calibration is banked; now the bar moves. Ride Wednesday with tempo, ≥17 running miles with two quality touches, and the volume floor is back on every lift day.
goals: The volume question, answered with the log: last week you did ~48 working sets and ~26k lb — Block 1's calibration week was 65 sets and ~37k lb, and its build weeks ran 86–87 sets and 45–48k. So yes, you were down about 30%, and your journals called it correctly (2-set accessories, thin core). This week is rebuilt to ~73 planned sets: back-off sets on the main lifts, 3-set accessories everywhere, a superset every lift day, and 6+ core sets every lift day. The only volume you're 'missing' vs Block 1 is the fourth barbell day — and that slot is deliberately your 25–30 mile ride.

Push week targets, straight off calibration: Squat 195×5 (was 185, felt easy — Block 1 best is 200×5, week 3 takes it), Bench 180×5 (was 175×5 solid, best 190), Strict OHP 110×5 (you beat the 100 placeholder with 105s), Deadlift 265×4 (was 255×4, best 275). Top sets at ~2 RIR, unspotted bench rules as always, full back protocol on every hinge.

Intensity distribution, recalibrated per your point: you're right that the hard-aerobic share has been too small, with one correction to the ledger — lifting doesn't belong in EITHER bucket. HR drifting through Z2 between sets isn't continuous aerobic work, so it doesn't count as easy volume any more than it counts as intensity; the 80/20 math should run over aerobic minutes only (runs + rides). By that ledger last week you did ~4.2 aerobic hours and about 18 hard minutes — roughly 7% hard, not 20%. So the diagnosis isn't 'too much Z2', it's that BOTH ends shrank: total aerobic minutes fell off and the hard minutes nearly vanished. While running volume sits this low, the rule is ~70/30 on aerobic minutes with TWO quality touches, converging back to 80/20 when Block 4 rebuilds volume. This week's hard ledger: ~20 min threshold Tue, ~30 min bike tempo Wed, ~18 min steady Fri, strides Sun — about 65–70 hard minutes on ~5 aerobic hours, ~23%.

Wednesday is the ride, and it carries the week's second quality touch: 25–30 miles with 2×15 min at tempo in the middle, steady Z2 everywhere else. Tempo on the bike is the cheapest intensity you can buy — real Z3 stimulus, zero pounding, no interference tax on Saturday's deadlifts. Eat before, fuel during, and it's logged under its own distance field so it doesn't inflate the run-mileage stat.

Core, rotated per the new floor: Mon = hollow hold / bird dog / suitcase carry, Thu = ab wheel / Pallof / woodchopper, Sat (deadlift day, spine-friendly) = side plank / dead bug / hanging leg raise. Six sets minimum each day, run as 20s-transition circuits. Friday's mini-pump adds 4 more.
Food: maintenance, deficit 0, band 189–191 with the waist as arbiter. You're fueling PR attempts and a 2-hour ride this week — under-eating is the one way to lose both.

Progress tab note: the daily lifting volume chart is gone — it mostly showed which days you lift. In its place is an 8-week lifting volume graph, so the exact drop we just diagnosed is visible on one screen from now on.
review: Calibration week delivered everything it needed to despite starting on an engagement weekend: Squat 185×5 easy, Bench 175×5, strict OHP 105×5 past its placeholder, Deadlift 255×4, and honest journals that reshaped this plan — the 6-set core floor and the third accessory set are your notes, now standing rules. Two honest readings to hold lightly: the pull-up benchmark at 14 (Block 2 exit was 18 — but that one came fresh on a calisthenics day; this one came the morning after a full upper session, so the trend is muddier than the number) and Thursday's intervals feeling terrible (day-after-squat legs, first outdoor speed in a month, and easy runs that have been creeping hot). Saturday's 26-mile ride with Morgan was the best kind of unplanned — legs sore, aerobic system fed. Week 2's job: move every bar 5–10 lb, put the set volume back, and make easy mean easy.

run.title: Cruise Intervals — 5.5 mi total
run.detail: 1.5 mi easy warm-up → 3 × 6 min at threshold effort (comfortably hard — short sentences, not gasps) with 2 min easy jog between → easy cool-down to round out 5.5. Last week's session kicked your butt because of day-after-squat legs and a month off speed — same legs situation today, so the assignment is CONTROL: start the first rep slower than feels right and finish each rep feeling like you could do one more. Feeling strong after rep 3? Take a 4th — the week's intensity budget has room now. If rep 1 blows past comfortably hard, cut reps to 5 min instead. The paper will look mediocre for a few more weeks; that's detraining unwinding, not your ceiling.

run.title: Progression Run — 4 easy + 2 steady
run.detail: The week's longest run, now a progression per the intensity rebalance: 4 miles genuinely easy (≤150 — your recent 'easy' has averaged ~152, which is no-man's-land; if honest Z2 means 10:30 miles right now, run 10:30 miles), then lift the last 2 miles to STEADY — Z3, comfortably brisk, ~155–165, the effort you could hold for an hour. Not threshold: deadlifts are tomorrow, and steady is the biggest stimulus that doesn't tax them. The discipline is both directions — easy miles actually easy, steady miles actually steady.
